## Checklist

- [ ] I've signed the [CLA](https://github.com/ban-red/cha-dash/blob/main/CLA.md) (the bot asks on your first pull request)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated, and they pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, real domains, public IPs or personal names in code, fixtures, logs or screenshots ([how to sanitize](https://github.com/ban-red/cha-dash/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#fixtures-and-privacy))
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording for UI changes, in light and dark themes
- [ ] Docs are updated if behavior or a decision changed (plan, ADR or user docs)
